parameter_status: EXPERT_ELICITED_UNCALIBRATED: every numeric value below (priors, likelihoods, reliabilities, thresholds) is an engineering assumption. Literature supports directions only, not values. Thresholds are provisional design parameters, not scientifically validated.

states_doc.W: latent investigation state: anomaly is reach-wide or upstream-originating (spatial extent), conditional on the anomaly being representative
states_doc.L: latent investigation state: anomaly source lies between the upstream viewpoint and the report site (spatial extent), conditional on the anomaly being representative
states_doc.N: representativeness/validity state: anomaly not persistent or not representative (artefact OR real-but-brief; the two are not distinguishable here). NOT a cause.

upstream_view.label: Look upstream (water clarity upstream of the report site)
upstream_view.field_status: EXTENSION_UNVERIFIED: an upstream water-aspect ANSWER is not confirmed as an OAH field; only the upstream photo is documented (secondary source). Treated as AquaForensics extension evidence until the app is checked.

recheck_60min.label: Re-observe the same site after about 60 minutes
recheck_60min.field_status: DOCUMENTED_SECONDARY: repeat assessment of water aspect. The 60-minute interval is an AquaForensics protocol, not an OAH rule. OAH answer-code mapping unverified.

second_downstream.label: Assess a second nearby location
second_downstream.field_status: DOCUMENTED_SECONDARY: OAH news item describes user-defined sampling locations and water-condition assessment. Answer-code mapping unverified.

inspect_pipes_works.label: Check the reach for pipes, sewage or works
inspect_pipes_works.field_status: DOCUMENTED_SECONDARY: native pipe/sewage/works questions. Answer-code mapping unverified.

extreme._note: STRESS DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; never used for classification

thresholds._status: PROVISIONAL design parameters; may be revised by held-out experiments
